summary: Hydro One Inc. furnished a Form 6-K with an exhibit news release announcing that Hydro One Networks Inc. and Hydro One Sault Ste. Marie LP jointly filed a leave-to-construct application with the Ontario Energy Board (OEB) for the North Shore Link, a new 230-kV transmission line from Mississagi TS to Third Line TS in Sault Ste. Marie. The $1.3 billion project, targeted for service in 2029, includes station upgrades and would offer nine First Nation partners a 50% equity stake in the line component. This is a routine regulatory infrastructure approval filing, not a special situation.
